name: mlp-9-57-exact
author: Claude Code (scheduled run)
description: Two hidden layers (9, 57) trained from scratch with Adam (cosine LR, lr 3e-3, 4000 epochs, batch 256), then fine-tuned with misclassified images weighted 9x (Adam, lr 1e-3, cosine decay, best-state tracking) until all 70k MNIST images are classified correctly. 8,215 parameters, below the 8,255 of mnist/mlp-9-59-exact.
